job.title: Corporate & Commercial Lawyers - Solicitor to Senior Associate
job.description:
Corporate and Commercial Lawyers – Three firms, three opportunities to take the next step
Ready for more responsibility, interesting work and closer client relationships? I'm recruiting for three corporate/commercial opportunities right now.
Each offers something different – breadth, balance or scale. One confidential conversation gives you the opportunity to explore and compare all three.

Associate / Senior Associate – Auckland CBD
Join a long-established, down-to-earth commercial law firm acting for privately owned businesses, corporates and organisations.
You'll work closely with partners and clients across a broad range of matters, including:
  • Mergers and acquisitions
  • Shareholder agreements, company restructures and corporate governance
  • Supply, distribution, services and technology contracts
  • Day-to-day commercial advice for owner-managed businesses and larger corporates
At Senior Associate level, you'll also supervise junior lawyers and help develop client relationships.
The firm is open on level, so experienced lawyers at either Associate or Senior Associate level are encouraged to apply. Enjoy genuine career progression, ongoing training and a collaborative team environment.

Commercial Solicitor (3–5 years' PQE) – Auckland CBD
A respected mid-sized firm with harbour views, acting for everyone from ambitious SMEs to large multinationals.
You'll enjoy a broad mix of M&A, contract negotiation, business structuring, governance, financing and IP work, with early responsibility and direct access to decision-makers.
The firm is part of a global alliance of independent law firms, providing opportunities for cross-border work and international lawyer exchanges.
Add flexible working, strong mentoring and a team that genuinely values life outside the office.

Senior Solicitor / Senior Associate (5+ years' PQE) – Christchurch (Auckland or Wellington considered)
Join the corporate team of a leading national firm and work on some of New Zealand's most significant transactions, including public-private partnerships, infrastructure, energy and financing deals for domestic and international clients.
You'll be based in a close-knit Christchurch office while working closely with colleagues in Auckland and Wellington.
Experience in infrastructure, energy or financing would be advantageous.
This is a rare opportunity to build your career within a top-tier practice while enjoying everything Christchurch has to offer.

What are we looking for?
Across all three opportunities, we're interested in lawyers with:
  • Corporate and commercial experience gained in New Zealand or a comparable jurisdiction, with NZ admission (or eligibility for admission)
  • M&A and commercial contracts experience, ideally with the ability to run matters from start to finish
  • Excellent drafting skills, sound judgement and a practical, commercially minded approach
  • Strong client relationship skills and an interest in business development
Not quite the right fit?
I also have other corporate/commercial opportunities in Auckland, including a growth-stage firm offering equity.
Even if you're not an exact match for the roles above, I'd still love to hear from you. There may be another opportunity worth discussing.

Interested in finding out more?
Apply now or contact me directly for a confidential conversation:
Email: sarah@legalpersonnel.co.nz
Call or text: 021 023 18312
Your details will never be sent to a firm without your permission.

Please note: Applicants must have the right to work in New Zealand. Unfortunately, these opportunities are not suitable for graduates.

job.title: Environment Lawyer | 2-5+ years | Auckland
job.description:
The Opportunity
Here’s your chance to step into a solicitor role with this highly respected boutique Environment Law firm, led by nationally recognised partners with extensive hands-on industry experience.
  
With a small team and a strong senior presence, you’ll be mentored closely and gain direct exposure to partners on complex, high-profile files. You’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility early, rather than waiting years for good work.
  
You’ll advise and represent a broad client base, including local authorities, developers, industry and individuals. Work includes:
  • District and regional plan changes, reviews and designations
  • Policy and legislative reform
  • Takutai Moana (Marine and Coastal Area) claims and litigation
  • Resource consents for major infrastructure and development projects, including fast-track applications
  • Environment Court appeals and dispute resolution
  • Compliance and enforcement matters
  
This is a chance to build your career at a time of major change in New Zealand’s resource management system, with a firm known for practical, commercially minded advice and strong advocacy.

The Culture
The firm culture is one of high performance and excellence but with a very down-to-earth and pragmatic attitude to the work that they do. They also value a collaborative, team approach.     

The Ideal You
Ideally, you will have strong academics and 2-5 years' experience, with experience in resource management/environmental law from another large, small or boutique New Zealand law firm.   It could be that you are in a top tier firm looking to make the move into a smaller boutique; or in a smaller suburban or provincial firm and looking to move into a more specialised RM practice; or maybe you have returned from overseas and are looking to secure your next role?  Either way you won't be disappointed in what you find here. 

How to Apply
Click on "Apply now" or contact us directly for more information about this opportunity. If this sounds like you, I would love to hear from you. Please contact Sarah on sarah@legalpersonnel.co.nz.

We will be reviewing suitable applications as they are received. If this role isn't for you but you'd like to know what else is available, please get in touch. We'd love to hear from you. As a boutique legal recruitment and search company, we have a range of roles at all levels for lawyers and support staff.

job.title: Employment Lawyer | 5+ Years | Auckland
job.description:
The Opportunity
Our client's highly regarded employment team is looking for an experienced lawyer to join them.

Working closely with two Employment Partners, you'll advise a diverse range of clients on practical, commercially sound employment solutions. You'll have strong client contact and the autonomy to run your own work, along with the chance to build your reputation in the employment law market.

The work is broad and varied. It covers everyday advisory work, collective bargaining and union matters, restructures, workplace investigations, disciplinary and performance processes, personal grievances, mediation, and litigation.

You'll be involved in complex and high-profile matters. For the right person, there is a clear path to career progression within the practice.
 
What we are looking for
Our client is looking for an employment lawyer at Associate or Senior Associate level, with around 5-7+ years' PQE.

You'll be a confident communicator with a client-focused approach. You'll be comfortable running your own matters while working as part of a close team, and you'll enjoy mentoring junior lawyers.
You will also bring:
  • Strong technical skills, commercial judgement, and attention to detail
  • Experience appearing in the Employment Relations Authority or Employment Court
  • Initiative and sound judgement when matters move quickly
  • A positive contribution to team culture
 
About the Firm
Our client offers quality work with direct client contact from the outset, and a collaborative and inclusive team culture.

Salary: $110,000 - $150,000 + KiwiSaver. We recognise that experienced candidates may sit well above this range and encourage you to apply. Remuneration will reflect your level of experience.

How to Apply

We will be reviewing suitable applications as they are received. If this role isn't for you but you'd like to know what else is available, please get in touch. We'd love to hear from you. job.title: Property and Private Client Lawyer
job.description:
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced property and private client lawyer to join an established Auckland firm known for its strong client relationships and supportive culture.

The role
You'll work across a varied practice with a focus on residential and commercial property transactions, alongside trusts, wills, estates, and succession planning. The role offers hands-on responsibility, meaningful client contact, and the chance to build trusted, long-term relationships.
You will manage matters from instruction through to settlement, delivering clear, practical advice and working closely with colleagues in a collaborative and professional environment.

What you'll be doing
  • Managing residential and commercial property transactions end to end
  • Drafting and negotiating property-related agreements and documentation
  • Advising on trusts, estate planning, and administration
  • Drafting wills, enduring powers of attorney, and related estate documents
  • Liaising with clients and professional advisers to ensure smooth outcomes
About you
  • Around 4+ years' experience in property and private client law
  • Strong experience across residential and commercial property transactions
  • Working knowledge of the Trusts Act 2019
  • Client-focused, practical, and commercially minded
  • Strong drafting skills and clear communication style
  • Interested in building long-term client relationships and developing your practice
Why Consider This Role?
  • Broad, interesting property and private client work
  • Supportive, professional, and approachable team
  • Real responsibility and direct client contact
  • A firm that values quality, balance, and long-term careers
This is a firm where lawyers are trusted with responsibility and supported to do their best work. If you would like to chat about this role, I would love to hear from you sarah@legalpersonnel.co.nz or 02102318312
